subsection.title: Permissions and Visibility
subsection.description: State who may view, create, change, confirm, share, or remove product content.

subsection.title: Confirmation and Changes
subsection.description: State which actions require confirmation, what becomes fixed, and what may still be revised or reversed.

subsection.title: Failure and Recovery
subsection.description: Optional. State failure or recovery behavior only when it applies across Features and the PoC must preserve or demonstrate it.

subsection.title: Accessibility and Sensitive Information
subsection.description: State applicable accessibility, privacy, and sensitive-information expectations in user-facing terms.
